doc.tool: Move {{the}} gripper by a bounded base-frame xyz delta in meters (x forward, y left, z up{{arm_frame}}; at most {{max_move}} m per call).
doc.code:
Translate the gripper by delta_xyz (m), holding the orientation; refused beyond the per-call limit (--max-move) or out of the floor/box (clamped, noted). Returns ok, pre_pose, post_pose, moved_m, notes.

Example:
    r = move_delta([0.0, 0.0, -0.02])   # 2 cm down
    print(r["ok"], r["moved_m"])

doc.code:
Close gripper and wait for it to settle; a close that caught nothing reopens (reopen_empty) and says so in notes. gripper_closed / gripper_width_m tell whether it holds something.

Example:
    r = close_gripper()
    print(r["gripper_width_m"], r["notes"])

doc.code:
One arm's state: eef_pose (xyz + quat xyzw, base frame), eef_pos, eef_euler_xyz, joints (6, rad), gripper_width_m, gripper_closed, heading_yaw_rad, yaw_from_reset_rad, z_floor_m; on two arms without `arm`: {"arms": {side: state}}.

Example:
    st = get_robot_state()
    print(st["eef_pos"], st["gripper_width_m"])

The cameras' frames (front and the wrist camera(s), HxWx3 uint8) and the robot state.

Example:
    obs = get_observation()
    front = obs["images"]["front"]  # HxWx3 uint8
    print(obs["robot_state"]["eef_pos"])

The cameras (topic, role) and the image size; the webcams have no calibration or depth.

doc.code:
One guarded step of one arm: translate (m), yaw (rad), then open/close; refused beyond the per-call limits (--max-move, --max-yaw), clamped to the floor and workspace box.

Example:
    r = step([0.0, 0.0, -0.02])      # 2 cm down (within the per-call limit)
    step(yaw=0.1, gripper="close")  # turn, then close
    print(r["ok"])

position.description: TCP [x, y, z] in the arm's base frame, m

arm.description: Which arm: 'left' or 'right' (two arms; required there, the other arm holds still). Omit on one arm

doc.code:
Solve inverse kinematics for the gripper from the current joints (nothing moves).

Returns:
    {reachable, joints (6, rad) or None, max_joint_change_rad, max_joint_step_rad}: one move_to_joints call may change a joint by at most max_joint_step_rad.

Example:
    st = get_robot_state()
    r = solve_ik([st["eef_pos"][0], st["eef_pos"][1], st["eef_pos"][2] - 0.02])
    if r["reachable"]:
        move_to_joints(r["joints"])

arm.description: Which arm: 'left' or 'right' (two arms; required there, the other arm holds still). Omit on one arm

doc.code:
Move the arm along a straight joint-space line to a joint configuration, bounded per call: each joint changes at most max_joint_step_rad, the gripper stays within the per-call limits (--max-move, --max-yaw) of where it starts, and the path stays above the floor and in the box; refused whole otherwise (nothing moves).

Example:
    q = get_robot_state()["joints"]
    q[0] += 0.05
    move_to_joints(q)
